title: Search results take 20 s
description: Searches took up to 20 seconds during the morning peak. Many customers gave up.
root_cause: The database connection pool of booking-search was exhausted after a traffic peak.
resolution: Increased the pool size and restarted the search pods.

title: Seat map not loading
description: The seat map stayed empty for about a third of the customers.
root_cause: The CDN served an old JavaScript bundle after a release of checkout-web.

title: Payments rejected with HTTP 503
description: Most payments failed with an error message. The provider answered with HTTP 503.
resolution: Switched to the backup provider until the provider recovered.

title: Disk full on node-7
description: node-7 ran out of disk space; two pods were evicted.
root_cause: Log rotation was disabled on node-7.
resolution: Re-enabled log rotation and removed old log files.

title: Certificate expired on the checkout domain
description: Browsers showed a security warning on the checkout pages.
root_cause: The TLS certificate was not renewed in time.
resolution: Renewed the certificate and added an expiry alert.

title: Login fails for some users
description: About 10 % of the logins failed with 'session invalid'.
root_cause: A signing key was rotated without refreshing the cache of the login service.

title: Ledger queries take seconds
description: Reports and refunds were delayed because queries on the ledger took several seconds.
root_cause: An index was missing after a schema migration.

title: Wrong prices in search results
description: The search showed old prices after the night import.
root_cause: The search cache was not cleared after the price import.
resolution: Cleared the cache and fixed the import job.

title: Payment step hangs after payment-api release 2.2.4
description: Ten minutes after release 2.2.4 the p95 latency of payment-api rose from 240 ms to 1.9 s. Customers reported a hanging payment step and failed payments.
root_cause: Release 2.2.4 changed the HTTP client of the payment provider: its connection pool was reduced from 50 to 5, requests queued.
resolution: Rolled back to 2.2.3 - latency normal after 25 minutes. Fixed in 2.2.5.

title: Booking confirmations delayed
description: Confirmation e-mails arrived up to two hours late.
root_cause: The mail queue had a backlog after a mass mailing.
resolution: Paused the mass mailing and scaled the mail workers.

title: Duplicate webhooks from the payment provider
description: Some bookings were confirmed twice; ledger entries were duplicated.
root_cause: The provider re-sent webhooks after a timeout, and the webhook handler was not idempotent.

title: Voucher codes rejected
description: Customers could not redeem the autumn campaign vouchers.
root_cause: The campaign end date in the configuration was wrong.
